stem: Which answer choice does NOT describe the number 7,140?

options.label: A
options.text: The sum of seven thousands and fourteen tens

options.label: B
options.text: The sum of seven thousands, one hundred, and forty tens

options.label: C
options.text: The sum of seven thousands, one hundred, and four tens

options.label: D
options.text: The sum of seven thousands, one hundred, and forty ones

difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding place values and translating verbal descriptions to numbers, identifying which description does not match 7,140.
